lock.unreadable: What was kept here can’t be opened.
lock.parent: A parent opens this profile, with their password or passkey.
lock.cantText: Without your passkey, password or recovery code, nobody can open what is kept here. Starting afresh deletes it; you can then restore a backup or your synced folder.
lock.afreshConfirm: Delete everything kept here, for good?
lock.noPasskey: No passkey could lock it here. Use a password instead.
lock.sealed: Everything kept here is encrypted on this device. Lock it, so only you can open it.
lock.withPasskey: Locked with your passkey. It opens only with it or your recovery code.
lock.withPassword: Locked with your password. It opens only with it or your recovery code.
lock.synced: Your synced folder keeps readable copies.
lock.short: At least 12 characters. A passkey is stronger.
lock.code: Your recovery code opens it if you lose your passkey or forget your password. Without them, nobody can open what is kept here. Keep it somewhere safe.
